description: Implementation of QuicConnectionMtuDiscoverer class for MTU discovery in QUIC protocol, including methods for enabling/disabling MTU probing, updating probe sizes, and internal state management.

classes.name: QuicConnectionMtuDiscoverer
classes.description: Class responsible for discovering the maximum transmission unit (MTU) size in QUIC connections by probing and adjusting packet sizes.

methods.name: QuicConnectionMtuDiscoverer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MTU discoverer with base probe count and next probe packet number.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables MTU discovery with specified maximum packet length and target maximum packet length.

methods.name: Disable
methods.description: Disables MTU discovery, resetting internal state.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if MTU discovery is currently enabled.

methods.name: ShouldProbeMtu
methods.description: Determines if an MTU probe should be sent based on current state and packet count.

methods.name: GetUpdatedMtuProbeSize
methods.description: Calculates and updates the size of the next MTU probe based on previous results.

methods.name: next_probe_packet_length
methods.description: Calculates the size of the next probe packet based on current min/max bounds.

methods.name: OnMaxPacketLengthUpdated
methods.description: Updates internal state when the maximum packet length is changed.
